_meta.title: repro_20260220_v7p2_markov_obs_prev_a
_meta.summary: V7P2 reproducibility config: AMRBicycleEnv observation adds prev_a_n so acceleration smoothness reward uses fully observable state.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v7p2 --episodes 40 --out v7p2_smoke --device cuda --progress
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v7p2 --models v7p2_smoke --runs 3 --out v7p2_smoke
notes: V7P2 keeps V7P1 reward coefficients and policy regime unchanged.
Behavior change is limited to observation schema: AMRBicycleEnv scalar part is now 11 (includes prev_a_n).
Old V7P1 checkpoints are not shape-compatible with V7P2 due obs_dim change.
